output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.
The transfer function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], which can be exploited to cause a denial of service.
The transferFrom function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], which can be exploited to cause a denial of service.

output_list.vulnerability: The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The approve function does not check if the newValue is large enough, which can overflow if it is large.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The burn function does not check if the balanceOf[msg.sender] is large enough, which can overflow if it is large.
